meta.about: Shared content for every top-bar proposal. Rooms and spaces are the app's real ones (app/src/rooms/*/definition.ts); stats use each room's real header wording.

fields.rooms[]: id, name, spaces[] (id, label, shortcut), stats (the room's header stats line), statsHover (token total)
fields.subjects: short / long subject titles per room; long is the truncation case
fields.states[]: the rows every proposal shows: id, caption, room, space, subject (key into subjects or null), width, menu (null or which menu is open)
fields.recent: recent subject titles per room, for menus and palettes that list subjects

meta.fixed: Lantern mark leads to the room's Welcome; window controls flush right; empty space drags; title opens the subject menu; at 1024 px mark, spaces, title, settings and window controls stay (RS-18).
